_comment: Realistic mock of a single OpenSky observation after extraction by OpenSkyProducer._build_raw_payload(). Represents a STATIC mode observation for the taiwan_strait bounding box on 2026-04-04. aircraft_count=47 represents a moderately elevated density. states_compact includes one aircraft (icao24='abc123') with lat=null and lon=null and on_ground=false — this is a transponder silence event that the Silver Job will count as transponder_silence_events=1 (domain filter applied in silver_job.py). The second aircraft ('def456') has valid position data and on_ground=false — not a silence event. A third aircraft ('ghi789') has lat=null/lon=null but on_ground=true — not a silence event (ground contact is expected). Section 4.4 / Section C.1 / Section B.7.
